{{Top|leg}}
'''Racketeering''' was an illegal business operation practiced by many criminal organizations, most notably by the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]]. There were many different variants of racketeering, such as extortion, trafficking illicit goods and money laundering.
